name: M3_OIS100MI_DltLineCharge
description: Delete order line charges for a specific customer order line. This operation removes a single charge identified by the order number, order line, and charge identity, so that the charge is no longer considered in order value and future invoicing.

inputParameters.name: ORNO
inputParameters.description: Customer order number identifying the order that contains the line charge to be deleted.

inputParameters.name: PONR
inputParameters.description: Order line number identifying the line from which the charge will be deleted.

inputParameters.name: CRID
inputParameters.description: Charge ID specifying which charge on the order line will be deleted.

inputParameters.name: POSX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying the specific subline from which the charge will be deleted.
